actions.action: Tap branches over white paper and inspect with a hand lens to tell thrips from spider mites
Place blue or yellow sticky traps near plants to monitor and reduce thrips
Inspect new growth, flower buds, leaf undersides and soil for thrips
Test 70% alcohol spray on a few leaves first
Spray plants with 70% alcohol in shade every 3-5 days for several weeks
Rotate treatments with spinosad, insecticidal soap or neem oil sprays
Alternatively remove and replace the top layer of potting media
Inspect new plants before adding them to the collection
Remove and bag badly damaged flowers

reason: The answer correctly identifies thrips as the main diagnosis but never mentions the beneficial predatory mites that actually fixed the problem, relying on sprays and soil treatments instead; nothing it recommends is likely to harm the plants.
